export_evidence: Company website (gemsons.com/countries-served): "Serving a range of global engineering companies, we export our world-class components across 5 continents. We have found a niche for ourselves in over 20 countries, which include USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Sweden, Norway, Germany, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Romania, Poland, UK, UAE, Singapore, Malaysia, China, Japan, India and many more." — this is a self-declaration only. No customs/B-L record with date, destination, HS code or B-L number was retrievable: ImportKey pages for both slug variants ('gemsons-precision-engineering-private-ltd' and 'gemsons-precision-engineering-pvt-ltd') returned only the generic template ('Loading...', 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records') with 0 visible shipment rows; volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript client challenge. Source counter: 5 trade-data sources attempted, 0 shipment rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved. The only domestic-market signal is the registered plant address on gemsons.com: "Plot No. - 9, Dewan Shah Udyog Nagar, Opp. IPOL Oil Company, Waliv Phata, Dist. Palghar. Vasai (East), Mumbai, Maharashtra, India - 401208" — an address, not a supply record. Search tooling was unavailable (DuckDuckGo/searx connection refused; Bing returned irrelevant results), so domestic evidence could not be checked.
note: Manufacturer profile is consistent with the declared HS codes (CNC machined components, oil & gas parts, investment castings, industrial fasteners — 730729/732690/848190), but per Rule 5 the export claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no dated shipment, destination-specific record, HS code or B-L number was found in any accessible trade-data source. Следов фактических поставок (ни экспортных, ни внутренних) в открытых источниках не найдено — только заявления сайта. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No rejection grounds: legal entity appears active with a live corporate site and plant address; HS codes not treated as a rejection criterion.
